summary.text: Daedalus marks a transaction you sent as Transaction pending until the Cardano network confirms it, and the funds it uses cannot be spent meanwhile. A payment that the network rejected is never confirmed, but Daedalus still lists it as pending. Canceling the transaction releases its funds.

problem.text: A payment that the network rejected is still listed as Transaction pending and holds the funds it uses.

symptoms.text: A sent transaction stays marked Transaction pending.
Daedalus showed an error when sending a payment, but the payment is listed as pending and the balance is lower.

user_phrases.text: My transaction is stuck on pending
How do I cancel a pending transaction?
The payment failed but my balance went down

daedalus.notes: Behavior read from the Daedalus 11.6.2 tag source and its English interface text, for the mainnet release without the CIP-30 dApp connector. Builds with the connector label pending and expired transactions differently. Check a newer release before relying on it for a later version.

causes.claim: The wallet records a payment as pending before the network accepts it. When the network rejects the payment, the wallet keeps the record and submits it again until it expires, so its funds stay reserved.

resolutions.why: Transactions lists the wallet's transactions with their status.

resolutions.action: Select the transaction marked Transaction pending.
resolutions.why: Its details show the options for a transaction that stays pending.

resolutions.action: Once the transaction has been pending for more than 10 minutes, select Cancel pending transaction.
resolutions.why: Daedalus offers cancellation after a transaction has been pending for 10 minutes.
Canceling releases the funds the transaction holds.

resolutions.action: If the transaction is marked Transaction failed instead, select Remove failed transaction.
resolutions.why: A transaction that expired before the network processed it holds its funds until it is removed.

resolutions.action: If sending the payment again fails with an error, open a support case in the support portal instead of sending it again. Each rejected attempt is listed as pending and holds more of the wallet's funds.
resolutions.why: The wallet records a payment as pending before the network checks it, so each rejected attempt is listed as pending again and holds the funds it uses. Support can look into a payment that the network keeps rejecting.

resolutions.action: When you open the support case, attach your logs to it.
resolutions.why: Daedalus asks for the downloaded logs with a support request, to help the support team investigate.

expected_outcome.text: The transaction is no longer listed, and its funds can be spent again.

consequences: If the network confirms a canceled transaction after all, it reappears in the wallet as a completed transaction.

evidence.rationale: Steps read from the Daedalus 11.6.2 tag source and its English interface text. The rejected-payment behavior is a repository collaborator's report, matched against the submission code of the cardano-wallet revision that 11.6.2 pins (f293d922f193). Source inspection, not runtime testing.
